notes.title: New Game Coming！
notes.content:
Feeling a bit bored at work? Come fishing!

Fishing On My Desktop is an idle fishing game that runs as a floating button on your desktop. Whether you’re working, studying, watching movies, or even playing other games, you can enjoy the fun of fishing at the same time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118349/6aac0b4c25b14153463aa195a6dee5204d5c98c7.png[/img]


[h1]Interesting Fishing Experience[/h1]

[list]
[*] Just a click to start fishing—no complex controls needed.
[*] Fish in rivers, lakes, and oceans.
[*] Collect over 100 different types of fish.
[*] Unique rods and bait options.
[*] Some unexpected catches: crabs, pearls, jellyfish, message bottles, and even treasure chests…
[/list]

[h1]And[/h1]

[list]
[*] The cutest cat in the world.
[*] 3 story-driven NPCs.
[*] Mysterious hidden fishing spots.
[/list]

Add to Wishlist and support the kitty.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3263340/_/]
Fishing on my Desktop  Steam Store Page[/url]

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Cat On My Desktop Version 1.1 Update!

Here are the details of this update: 

[list]
[*] Added new cat colors: Orange Cat and Gray Cat.
[*] Added custom cat size options. 
[*] Added custom speech bubble size options.
[*] Added a new cat action: Cat Toast (before the cat falls asleep). 
[*] You can now name your cat.
[*] Updated the cat’s response logic: now the cat won’t wake up when the mouse passes over it, only clicks will wake it up.
[*] Added support for secondary monitors.
[*] Added game frame rate adjustment. 
[/list]


Thank you all for your support. Cat loves you~~
